headline: Nevish Line Surges as Weathered Expanse Fight Continues
war_summary: Three hours on the wires have put the Nevish Line back atop the late returns with twelve turns in two hours and fifty-seven in the day about Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, holding six Warden to two Colonial after 6,854 casualties a side in the day with both rates accelerating to the hour. The Weathered Expanse follows with seven turns in two hours and fifty-two in the day about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, now two Warden to three Colonial with four neutral after 5,554 Colonial and 6,070 Warden casualties in the day. Kuura Strand, Marban Hollow and Linn Mercy show no turn in two hours after thirty-eight, thirty-two and eleven in the day at Faden Point, Checkpoint Bua and Lathair, with Kuura Strand now six Colonial to none. The Dead Lands reports 541 Colonial and 1,328 Warden casualties in two hours with sharply accelerating loss but no recorded turn, while Callahan's Passage cools to 473 and 253 with no flip.
